title: Adopt in Chatticus
description:
**Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.

**Milestone:** Later, coarse

**Goal.** Chatticus takes the `caducus` package in its own deployment and accounts, with nothing shared at runtime: one operator listener per account, its own alarm catalog, table and SES identity, and its own two last-resort alerts. Replace the SNS email in `infra/lib/alarms.ts`. TypeScript hosts run the package as Python Lambdas. Its SES was in the sandbox on 2026-11-04, which is enough for verified operators; production access is its own request when it sends to customers. Chatticus's repo and session own the merge.

**Acceptance.**
Spec'd when started.
